name: Cosmic Rays
description: Energy from space itself is spread onto the battlefield making latent psychic energy bolster and third eyes open wider
effect:
- All Non-screen battlefield effects increase in duration from 4 rounds to 7 rounds.
- Weather Control rolls to keep this weather activated or overtake another weather are increased by 2 Successes.
- Psychic, Fairy and Ghost-Type moves hit Lowest Defense stat of Target. 
- Psychic-Type Moves do +1 Damage.
